title: Docker Desktop fails to start after an update

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

input.subject: Docker Desktop won't start after update

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
Since this morning's update Docker Desktop won't start. It shows 'Docker Desktop failed to start' with a button to reset to factory defaults. I can still write code but can't run any of the local services.

Aisha

triage.subcategory: app fails to launch after update

handling.escalation_reason: No runbook covers it, and the one fix on screen (factory reset) deletes her images and containers.

rationale: She can work, partly: P3. No runbook applies, so no unattended reply (G6). The 'laptop running slowly' runbook shares words ('update', 'start') and would mislead. Factory reset is destructive for her data, which is one more reason this belongs with a person.
